selection: Every retained round JSON record from775 through fixed admission-capture cutoff with a finite nonnegative logged wall_seconds value. No latency/outcome filtering; missing durations remain missing.
scope: Recorded in-round wall seconds, including timed work and waits; not inter-round elapsed gaps, proposal latency, serving throughput or independent learning. Legacy records need not carry a completion flag.
source_binding: Logged aggregate field interpretation only; exact installed source, adapter, candidate pools, normalization and evaluation-population closure remain unqualified.
